Dialect: DuckDB
Columns:
weather(time TIMESTAMP, city VARCHAR, temperature DOUBLE)
Städte "x"()
Question: Daily average temperature in Berlin during 2024 
Previous title: Daily average temperature in Berlin, 2024
Latest change: Use monthly buckets	instead of daily buckets.
SQL:
SELECT date_trunc('month', time) AS month, avg(temperature) AS temperature FROM weather WHERE city = 'Berlin' AND time >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND time < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
